_comment: Claude Code harness MCP scope for Starlight Orchestrator. Mirrors the shape of ~/.claude/settings.json mcpServers field. Canonical: starlight-substrate is always loaded. Task-scoped MCPs declared per session via /ao or per-task config. Built on SIP — see footer.
_loaded_when: default — any task touching SIS, brand-critical writes, or > 200 LOC changes

starlight-substrate._purpose: substrate awareness — vault reads, IS namespace lookup, attestation generation, memory graph queries

arcanea-mcp._role: canon-work scoped — load when editing Arcanea canon, Guardians, Vel'Tara archetypes, or vibeclubs.ai surfaces
arcanea-mcp._purpose: Arcanea canon read/write, Guardian Passport flow, creative-intelligence transmissions
arcanea-mcp._status: scaffold — wire when Arcanea MCP server lands; Phase 1 dependency

_task_scoped_mcps._comment: These MCPs declare per-session via /ao config, not loaded by default. Listed here for discovery; harness operator activates as needed. Examples are illustrative — do not treat as exhaustive.

vercel._purpose: deploy + project read for site/ writes
vercel._load_when: Phase 3 spine surfaces ship (frankx.ai/score, arcanea.ai/passport, starlight.systems/cards)
vercel._pattern: use mcp__claude_ai_Vercel__* tools when available; otherwise CLI via Bash

github._purpose: PR review, multi-repo coordination, release management
github._load_when: /luminor-board verdict routes to a PR ship
github._pattern: gh CLI via Bash is canonical; gh-mcp optional

linear._purpose: issue tracking when alliance work crosses Linear

notion._purpose: Ops Hub sync — daily briefs, ship logs

remotion-video._purpose: Voice & Video IS pipeline — composition, render

_secrets_policy._comment: No real tokens or secrets in this file. Use environment-variable references like ${VERCEL_TOKEN}. Secrets live in machine env or .env files outside the repo. The harness layer mostly does not need secrets at scaffold stage — those land per-session when the task demands.
